about: Game-ready props for Ashen Abyss (glTF binary, +Y up, metres, textures embedded; Godot uses glTF axes as they are). triangles / size / bounds are measured from the .glb files. size = bounding box [x, y(height), z] in metres; bounds.min/max are local Godot coordinates. origin: base centre on the ground unless stated ('top centre' = hang point, 'as authored' = wall mount point); below_ground = how far the mesh extends under y=0 (natural props are meant to be sunk). category is one of categories[]; kind is a finer label. mount: floor | surface (table top or floor) | wall | ceiling. blocks = suggested nav obstacle, radius = half the larger horizontal extent. casts_light props carry light{color, range_m, energy, flame_pos, flame_positions}: local Godot coordinates for OmniLight3D + fire particles (flame_pos = centre of all flames). alpha 'mask' = alpha scissor, 'blend' = glass. interactive = meant for a gameplay object, keep out of random scatter. parts = separate child nodes with their pivots. by_zone[zone][category] lists prop names for the level themes; build_procedurally lists what the CC0 sources do not offer.

build_procedurally.item: gravestones, grave slabs, broken markers, burial mounds
sarcophagi with separate lids, wall niches, coffins
build_procedurally.textures: dark_marble / worn_marble / big_blocks; coffins dark_planks + rusty_iron

build_procedurally.item: pews, lectern, altar, choir stalls, confessional
build_procedurally.textures: varnished_wood / dark_panel_wood / red_velvet / aged_gold (journal_open sits on the lectern)

build_procedurally.item: market stalls, awnings, tents, handcart, well, signposts, fences, palisade
build_procedurally.textures: old_planks / rough_beam / canvas / thatch / rope / log_wall / wicker

build_procedurally.item: beacon tower (ember tower) and the great brazier of the hub; standing braziers (tripod / plinth under brazier_bowl), wall torches and sconces
glowing fungus clusters, cattail / reed clumps, lily pads, hanging moss
build_procedurally.textures: emissive shader for fungus caps; alpha cards or thin blades for reeds; moss

build_procedurally.item: icicles, ice crystals and shards, snow drifts, frozen-over ruins
build_procedurally.textures: ice_pale / ice / snow_fresh (snow_* props are the baked snowy rocks)

build_procedurally.item: snow / moss / ash overlay on any other prop (shader: blend by world-space up normal)
obsidian spires and crystal clusters, lava rocks, hanging chains, cages, ember vents
bone piles, skulls, cobwebs, iron bars and grates, wall chains
build_procedurally.textures: worn_marble tinted bone; alpha cards for cobwebs; rusty_iron

build_procedurally.item: obelisks, broken column drums, sand drifts, brass gears / pipes / machinery, brass doors
banners, drapes, carpets and aisle runners, sacks, bedrolls
boardwalk railings, rope bridges, mooring posts, small boats
build_procedurally.textures: mossy_planks / old_planks / rope (pier_* props are the deck pieces)

build_procedurally.item: arches, vaults, buttresses, window tracery, stairs, rubble piles, ruined wall chunks
